LESSON: LAUNDERING COTTON ITEM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.3: Laundering Cotton Item

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Laundering Cotton Item. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Laundering Cotton Item
2. Practise Laundering Cotton Item at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Laundering Cotton Item

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Laundering Cotton Item
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Laundering Cotton Item. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Laundering Cotton Item at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Laundering Cotton Item at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Laundering Cotton Item
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Laundering Cotton Item. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Laundering Cotton Item using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Laundering Cotton Item in the examples.
2. Explain Laundering Cotton Item to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Laundering Cotton Item.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Laundering Cotton Item using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Laundering Cotton Item important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Laundering Cotton Item
2. Practise Laundering Cotton Item at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Laundering Cotton Item

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
